annotations.title: Get a product with its prices

description: One product of the registry with its current prices by country, chain and store, in local currency and EUR, each with the day it was seen, its source and its evidence; per country the lowest price and the median over chains. Use "proof" to prove one of these prices against the published daily receipt. Costs 1 credit (0.002 USDC with x402).

chain.description: Only this chain id (see the chains tool).

country.description: Limit to these countries (ISO-2 country code in lower case (al, at, ba, be, bg, ch, cy, cz, de, dk, ee, es, fi, fr, gb, gr, hr, hu, ie, is, it, lt, lu, lv, mt, nl, pl, pt, ro, rs, se, si, sk, tr)); default all.

product.description: Registry id (e.g. "1779"), "ean:<code>", "ian:<code>", or a barcode of 8–14 digits.

status.description: "current" = seen in the latest run of its source; "last_seen" = the last price seen, older than the latest run.
